title: Bought furniture on Black Friday? How to get it home today
summary: A Black Friday price only works if you can take the purchase home. Check stock, dimensions and pickup before you pay.
body_markdown:
A[Black Friday](https://lugg.com/blog/what-shoppers-haul-home-on-black-friday) furniture deal only works if you can take it home. The logistics tend to show up after you decide to buy: the store may need the item collected that day, the box may not fit in your car, or the route into your home may be tighter than expected. Lugg is an on-demand moving and delivery platform for large purchases: book a pickup from the store, choose the vehicle you need, and have movers bring the item into your home.


Black Friday 2026 falls on **Friday, November 27** , with Cyber Monday on **Monday, November 30** .


Cyber Monday is more likely to involve online orders, but the same plan applies when a retailer offers store pickup: confirm the item is ready for release, get the boxed dimensions, and arrange the trip home before checkout.


Shoppers often find the item first and arrange a way to get it home afterward: across completed Lugg store pickups over the last three Black Friday weekends, about half were booked within four hours of the pickup window, and more than a third within two. Most were scheduled for later that same day.


## What should you confirm before buying a Black Friday furniture deal?


Purchase Confirm before you pay Plan before pickup


Sofa or floor model It is in stock, sold as-is if applicable, and the store will release it today Box or item dimensions, doorways, turns and pickup deadline


Mattress Packaged dimensions and the store's release rules A vehicle sized for the packaged mattress and the route to the bedroom


TV Boxed dimensions and manufacturer handling guidance A secure vehicle plan and the route to the installation wall


Appliance The exact model is available and the home route is ready Doorways, installation requirements and a plan for the old appliance


Ask four questions before you pay: Is the item in stock? Can the store release it today? What are its boxed dimensions? And what is the pickup deadline?


Floor models are usually the time-sensitive purchase. Ask whether the item is sold as-is, what is included, whether the store will hold it, and exactly when it must leave the showroom.


*Updated for Black Friday 2026: this guide focuses on pickup planning rather than deal tracking. Confirm current inventory, pickup deadlines and retailer policies directly with the store.*


## When should you plan a Black Friday furniture pickup?


Start planning before the rush, ideally once you have narrowed your list to items you would buy if they are in stock. Save the store address, measure the route into your home, and decide which vehicle you would need for the largest item on your list.


Check a retailer's own sale page for current dates, inventory and pickup rules. Deal roundups can help you find an offer; the store is the source for whether that particular item is available to collect.


If the store's delivery window does not work for you, ask whether the item can be released for pickup instead. That answer can change the purchase from a future delivery into something you can bring home today.


If you are still deciding whether to buy now or wait,[the best time to buy furniture](https://lugg.com/blog/best-time-to-buy-furniture) depends more on the item's category than on the sale weekend. And if you need an in-stock alternative,[discount furniture outlets](https://lugg.com/blog/discount-furniture-outlets) can be worth checking year-round.


## How do you get a Black Friday mattress home?


Yes, if you plan for its packaged size, protection in transit, and the path from your door to the room where it will go. A mattress is a simple purchase to make and an awkward one to transport.


Once you have chosen the mattress, arrange transport before checkout so it is not left at the store or forced into a vehicle that is too small. When in doubt, size up. Choose based on the packaged dimensions and the largest item, not what looks like it should fit in your car.


## Can you get a Black Friday TV home the same day?


Yes, but only if the boxed TV can travel securely and fit through the route to its final wall. For a large TV, the problem is not finding an offer. It is getting a tall, wide box from the store to the room where the TV will be used without damaging it.


Measure the box, not the screen. Check the manufacturer's handling guidance, plan a vehicle that can carry it securely, and measure the turns, doorway and wall where it will be installed before buying. For a large TV, follow the manufacturer's handling instructions, which usually say to keep it upright.


If you're buying the big one, measure the box rather than the screen, and settle how it's getting home before you're standing at the register deciding. A TV bought on a Friday afternoon and delivered the same day is a very different weekend from a TV that sits at the store until a delivery slot opens.


For a new screen that won't safely fit in your car,[same-day TV delivery](https://lugg.com/tv-delivery) can bring it home from the store.


## What should you check before bringing home a Black Friday appliance?


Confirm that the exact model can be released today and that the route into your home is ready for it. Measure the appliance, the doors, hallways and delivery route. Also decide what will happen to the old appliance before the new one arrives; store pickup, retailer haul-away, donation and disposal all have different requirements.


If you use Lugg for pickup, enter the pickup and destination addresses before booking so you can see the available vehicle and service options. Confirm local donation or disposal acceptance before adding an extra stop. For a refrigerator, washer, or range, Lugg movers can pick it up from the store and carry it into the room where it belongs with[appliance delivery](https://lugg.com/services/appliance-delivery) .


## How does same-day Black Friday store delivery work?


Same-day Black Friday store delivery starts after you have bought the item and the store can release it. Confirm the pickup details first, then choose whether to book right away or for a time you select.


### 1: Confirm the item can be released for pickup


Before you book, confirm that the exact item is in stock, ask when the store can release it, and get the boxed dimensions. For a floor model, also ask whether it is sold as-is and whether the store will hold it.


### 2: Choose on-demand or scheduled delivery


If you find an in-stock item unexpectedly, on-demand puts movers on the way within the hour. If you know when you want to shop, choose a one-hour arrival window, say 1–2 PM, up to 60 days ahead. Either way, the pickup can happen on the same day you buy the item.


### 3: Choose the vehicle and book the pickup


Enter the store address and your destination, choose a vehicle based on the item's boxed dimensions, and review the upfront estimate before booking. Movers can carry eligible items through stairs, elevators and hallways to the room where they belong.


## What should you measure before a Black Friday store pickup?


Measure the item's box or packaged dimensions, the vehicle opening, and the narrowest doorway or turn on the route into your home. If any measurement is close, choose a larger vehicle before you leave the store.


Measure the narrowest doorway on the route, not just the front door. For a sofa, measure its depth and the turns it must make. For anything boxed, measure the box, because it is larger than the product in every direction.


For sofas specifically, the diagonal beats the width. A couch that looks two inches too wide for the door usually isn't, once it's standing on one end. Lugg's guide to[moving a couch](https://lugg.com/blog/how-to-move-a-couch) has the full method.


## What should you do before paying for a Black Friday furniture deal?


Before you pay, confirm the item is in stock, ready for pickup today, able to fit through your home, and matched to the right vehicle. Then[book a store delivery](https://lugg.com/store-delivery) and take it home the same day.
